key_highlights: ASX pressured as banks and miners weigh on index following shaky Wall Street session; however, equities buck broader asset sell-off
AUD 'trapdoor' opens amid rate-pincer dynamics; RBA signals continued hikes despite surging unemployment
House prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline; >50% of renters financially stressed
$2.7B cap raise torrent tests broker capacity and small-cap liquidity
Gold exploration sector active: Aurum, Zenith, Kuniko, Auric report strong WA/West African results
Data centre boom straining energy supply, creating structural tension for AGL, CSG, WGE
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags urgent tax reform need; fiscal sustainability risk rising
Jetstar industrial action escalates with fee waivers; consumer transport sector under strain

sectors.trend: Large-cap miners (BHP, RIO, FMG) under pressure from Wall Street spillover and AUD weakness; however, gold juniors (Aurum, Zenith, Kuniko, Auric) deliver strong exploration hits in WA and West Africa, supporting speculative flows
sectors.implications: Divergence between large-cap iron ore/coal names and gold exploration; AUD weakness boosts AUD-denominated commodity revenues but caps equity valuations; Rio2 Peruvian copper drill assault signals long-term supply expansion

sectors.trend: Big Four (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) weigh on ASX; rate-pincer environment (hiking into rising unemployment) compresses net interest margin outlook; $2.7B cap raise activity increases underwriting risk
sectors.implications: NIM pressure from policy rate hikes vs. credit deterioration risk; Intergenerational Report tax reform could alter deposit/loan dynamics; bond market volatility threatens fixed-income book valuations

sectors.trend: Data centre boom creating structural energy demand surge but supply constraints; potential 'energy bust' if generation capacity lags; AGL, CSG, WGE face capacity investment pressure
sectors.implications: Long-term tailwind for generators and grid operators but near-term margin squeeze; LNG exporters (Santos, Woodside) benefit from global energy tightness

sectors.trend: House prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline; CBD commercial tower listed at $40m; Dusty Martin $20m portfolio haircut signals broad-based property devaluation
sectors.implications: Residential REITs (OGP, VMC, ICPS) face falling asset values and rising vacancy; commercial REITs under pressure from CBD disuse; mortgage stress rising with rate hikes

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates; >50% renters financially stressed; single-parent penalty and cost-of-living pressures weigh on discretionary spend; WES, WOW, QAN under pressure
sectors.implications: Defensive consumer staples (WES, WOW) relatively resilient; discretionary (QAN, LOL, DEX) face demand softness; Jetstar (JLH) faces operational disruption

sectors.trend: Global AI chip race (Nvidia, AMD, Intel, SK Hynix) drives US tech volatility; Australian tech exposure limited but CSL remains key healthcare anchor; AI safety legislation (Pocock) may affect local tech regulation
sectors.implications: CSL.AX provides defensive healthcare exposure; AI regulation debate could impact ASX-listed software firms; global tech sentiment transmits via ^AXJO

AUD structural weakness: 'trapdoor' dynamics threaten import costs and equity valuations

Consumer squeeze: renter stress, industrial action, and cost-of-living pressures

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hikes into rising unemployment (stagflation)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight defensive sectors (healthcare, staples); reduce leverage; monitor RBA statement language for pivot signals
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners (BHP, RIO) whose USD revenues offset AUD weakness; avoid import-heavy consumer names
Underweight residential REITs; monitor NIM and credit loss provisions at Big Four banks; watch mortgage arrears data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bond market volatility spilling into equities
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain duration hedges; monitor 10-yr GBA yields; reduce duration in fixed-income allocations

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply constraints from data centre demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AGL, CSG, WGE capex guidance; favour LNG exporters with long-term offtake contracts
Diversify commodity exposure; monitor iron ore and LNG pricing for demand shocks

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold exploration juniors on strong WA/West African results
opportunities.rationale: Aurum (155g/t), Zenith (6/6 hits), Kuniko, Auric all report high-grade gold; AUD weakness boosts gold equity valuations; resource updates imminent

opportunities.recommendation: Favour large-cap miners with USD revenue exposure
opportunities.rationale: AUD trapdoor benefits BHP, RIO, FMG on USD-denominated commodity sales; Rio2 Peruvian copper drill signals long-term supply growth

opportunities.recommendation: Position in energy generators ahead of data centre demand
opportunities.rationale: Structural energy demand from data centres supports AGL, CSG, WGE capex and pricing power over 12-24 months

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain CSL as core defensive holding
opportunities.rationale: Healthcare anchor in stagflation environment; global demand for blood products and vaccines (measles outbreak) supports pricing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to residential and commercial REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year house price decline underway; CBD tower listings at $40m signal structural oversupply; renter stress threatens occupancy
Rate-pincer (hiking into unemployment) compresses NIM; credit losses may rise; $2.7B cap raise activity increases underwriting risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim discretionary consumer and transport exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Jetstar industrial action, renter stress, and cost-of-living squeeze pressure WES, WOW, QAN, JLH
Bond market instability and 'everything crashes except stocks' divergence signals fragile risk-on; preserve dry powder

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain range-bound to modestly lower over 1-3 months. RBA hawkish bias vs. rising unemployment creates policy uncertainty. AUD weakness provides partial offset for miners but caps broad-market upside. Property correction and consumer stress weigh on sentiment. Gold juniors and energy names offer relative outperformance.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots on unemployment data. Intergenerational Report tax reform could unlock fiscal space. Gold exploration pipeline (WA, West Africa) supports sustained junior mining activity. Energy transition demand from data centres creates multi-year structural tailwind for generators. Key risk: property credit cycle inflection triggering broader financial stress.
